authoringStatement: All symbols, AST fields, canonical strings, durations, ranges, diagnostics, draft structures, and mutation expectations were manually transcribed or derived from the reviewed grammar, public F1 domain shapes, exact PPQ-960 arithmetic, and UTF-16 indexing before T0 production parsing existed.
independenceRules: Fixture validation may decode JSON shape but may not import a production parser, formatter, tokenizer, suggestion engine, chart allocator, or resolver.
T0 fixtures assert syntax AST only. T1 owns extension closure, chord-tone spelling, formula realization, and musical analysis.
Boundary recipes are declarative source materialization instructions and never call production code.

authorities.covers: declared symbol/chart grammar, aliases, modes, diagnostics, canonicalization, and refusal policy
spelling-first pitch identity and the public ChordSpec field representation
quarter-note beat units, meter capacity, PPQ-960 denominators, exact allocation, and reduction

sourceRefs: ECMA-262 2025 edition, sections 6.1.4 and 22.1 String Objects, https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/text-processing.html#sec-string-objects

maj7/minor substring corruption, C9/C13 missing sevenths, unsupported-quality default, and prefix drift
